name: Exp_derivative
summary: This EA trades based on the derivative (rate of change) of a price series, entering positions when the momentum derivative signals a directional shift. It calculates the mathematical derivative of price to detect acceleration or deceleration in trend movement, opening trades when the derivative crosses key thresholds. The strategy aims to capture early trend momentum shifts before they become visually apparent on the chart.
summary_zh: 该EA基于价格序列的导数（变化率）进行交易，当动量导数信号出现方向性转变时开仓。它通过计算价格的数学导数来检测趋势运动的加速或减速，在导数穿越关键阈值时开仓交易。该策略旨在捕捉趋势动量转变的早期信号。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是基于价格导数（即价格变化的速率）来判断市场动量的方向和强度。入场条件为当价格导数从负转正时做多，从正转负时做空，这代表着动量方向的拐点。出场条件则是在导数信号反转时平仓，或通过止损/止盈参数控制风险。仓位管理方面，EA使用固定手数或基于资金的仓位计算方式。资金管理依赖于输入参数中的止损和止盈设置来控制每笔交易的风险敞口。该策略的理论优势在于能够提前捕捉趋势的启动点，因为导数变化先于价格本身的显著移动。然而，在震荡市中导数信号频繁翻转可能导致连续亏损，缺乏过滤机制是其主要短板。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept is based on the price derivative (rate of price change) to determine the direction and strength of market momentum. Entry conditions trigger a long position when the price derivative crosses from negative to positive, and a short position when it crosses from positive to negative, representing inflection points in momentum direction. Exit conditions close positions when the derivative signal reverses, or through stop-loss and take-profit parameters. Position sizing uses either a fixed lot size or an equity-based calculation method. Money management relies on the input parameters for stop-loss and take-profit to control risk exposure per trade. The theoretical advantage is the ability to capture early trend initiation points since derivative changes precede significant price movements. However, in ranging markets the derivative signal can flip frequently, leading to consecutive losses, and the lack of a filtering mechanism is a notable shortcoming.
pros: 基于数学导数的入场逻辑具有理论创新性，能够捕捉动量拐点
策略逻辑清晰简洁，参数较少易于理解和调优
利用导数先于价格变化的特性，理论上可以提前进场获得更好的成交价
设置了止损止盈参数，具备基本的风险控制框架
pros_en: The derivative-based entry logic is theoretically innovative and can capture momentum inflection points
Strategy logic is clear and concise with few parameters, easy to understand and optimize
Leverages the property that derivative changes precede price changes, potentially enabling earlier entries with better fill prices
Includes stop-loss and take-profit parameters providing a basic risk control framework
cons: 在震荡行情中导数信号频繁翻转会导致大量虚假信号和连续亏损
缺乏市场状态过滤机制（如ADX趋势强度过滤），无法区分趋势和震荡市
导数计算对噪音敏感，短周期参数下容易产生误导信号
没有新增K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
缺少点差过滤，在高压点差时段交易成本可能侵蚀利润
cons_en: In ranging markets the derivative signal flips frequently, generating numerous false signals and consecutive losses
Lacks a market regime filter (such as ADX trend strength), unable to distinguish trending from ranging conditions
Derivative calculation is sensitive to noise, short-period parameters can easily produce misleading signals
No new bar check mechanism, may repeatedly open positions on the same bar
Missing spread filter, trading costs during high-spread periods can erode profits
improvements: 增加ADX或波动率过滤机制，仅在趋势明确时交易，避免震荡市中的虚假信号
添加新增K线检查和点差过滤，提高交易执行的稳健性
考虑使用多重时间框架确认，例如在H4趋势方向一致时才在H1上开仓
improvements_en: Add ADX or volatility filtering to trade only when trend is clear, avoiding false signals in ranging markets
Implement new bar check and spread filter to improve trade execution robustness
Consider multi-timeframe confirmation, such as only opening positions on H1 when H4 trend direction aligns

risk_points: 缺乏新增K线检查可能导致同一K线上重复开仓，增加风险敞口
没有点差过滤在高压时段可能产生不利成交
震荡市中导数信号频繁翻转可能造成连续亏损
risk_points_en: Lack of new bar check may cause repeated position openings on the same bar, increasing risk exposure
No spread filter can result in unfavorable fills during high-spread periods
Frequent derivative signal flipping in ranging markets can cause consecutive losses

It calculates the mathematical derivative of price to detect acceleration or deceleration in trend movement, opening trades when the derivative crosses key thresholds. The strategy aims to capture early trend momentum shifts before they become visually apparent on the chart.
